question.text: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Apple)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the diluted earnings per share (EPS) in conformity with US generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) reported in each company's first official quarterly earnings release after September 30, 2026. This is expected to be released no earlier than:

* Apple Q4 FY2026 November 2, 2026 ([source](https://finance.yahoo.com/calendar/earnings?symbol=AAPL))
* AMD Q3 FY2026 November 3, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMD/earnings))
* Amazon Q3 FY2026 October 29, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/AMZN/earnings))
* Meta Q3 FY2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/META/earnings))
* Microsoft Q1 FY2027 October 28, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/MSFT/earnings))
* Nvidia Q3 FY 2027 November 25, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/NVDA/earnings))
* SpaceX Q3 FY 2026 October 20, 2026 ([source](https://www.wallstreethorizon.com/spacex-earnings-calendar))
* Tesla Q3 FY 2026 October 21, 2026 ([source](https://seekingalpha.com/symbol/TSLA/earnings))

The earnings reports are typically released on the respective companies' investor relations websites and filed with the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/search-filings) as a Form 8-K.
question.fine_print:
Only the initially reported figures encompassing the entirety of the quarter will be considered. Any subsequent revisions, corrections, or restatements will not affect resolution. 

If a company does not publicly report earnings after September 30, 2026 and before January 1, 2027 or if it ceases to operate as a standalone public company, that specific subquestion will be **annulled**.

research:
I've finished the research and am writing it up now. The short version: nothing has been reported yet, and Apple's own guidance points to diluted EPS of roughly $1.97 to $2.06.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-06: Apple will publish Q4 FY2026 results (quarter ended September 26, 2026) on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. PT. The call starts at 2:00 p.m. PT with CEO John Ternus, on his first call as CEO, and CFO Kevan Parekh. The release goes on Apple's newsroom and to the SEC as an 8-K Exhibit 99.1. [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/06/apple-q4-2026-earnings-nov-2/), [MacDailyNews](https://macdailynews.com/2026/10/07/apple-to-report-q426-earnings-on-monday-november-2nd/), [MacObserver](https://www.macobserver.com/news/apple-q4-2026-earnings-november-2-ternus-first-call/)
- The latest value in the resolving series is Q3 FY2026 (reported 2026-07-30): diluted GAAP EPS of $2.02. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000018/a8-kex991q3202606272026.htm)
- Kalshi lists Apple's call as "Oct 29, 2026". That conflicts with every other source, which all say November 2. It is probably a placeholder date.

## 2. Current status
- The quarter has not been reported, so nothing is settled. The quarter closed on 2026-09-26.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-26: Apple stock hit a record intraday high of $351.73 and closed at $347.73. The driver was demand for the $1,999 foldable "iPhone Duo", which went on sale October 23, after the quarter ended. That means it affects Q1 FY2027, not this report. [MoneyCheck](https://moneycheck.com/apple-aapl-stock-hits-all-time-high-as-iphone-duo-demand-outpaces-supply/), [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/26/1-reason-apple-could-outperform-in-2027/)
- 2026-10-26: Zacks consensus is $2.00 EPS (up 8.1% year over year) on revenue of $112.95B. [Zacks](https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/3014919/apple-aapl-earnings-expected-to-grow-should-you-buy)
- 2026-10-26: Other consensus figures: MarketBeat $1.99 on $113.31B; Yahoo $1.98; 24/7 Wall St. $1.978 on $113.36B. 24/7 Wall St. flags a squeeze from memory costs. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-11-2-apple-inc-stock/), [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/26/apples-5-trillion-dilemma-3-reasons-earnings-could-spark-a-breakout-on-nov-2-or-a-meltdown/), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/apple-just-became-most-valuable-174837517.html)
- October 2026: Goldman Sachs forecasts $2.01 EPS and 47.8% gross margin, with a $390 price target. [KuCoin/Goldman](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/goldman-sachs-forecasts-apple-q4-earnings-iphone-18-series-drives-growth-target-price-raised-to-390)
- 2026-07-30, Apple's Q4 guidance:
  - Revenue growth of 9-11% year over year, about $111.7-113.7B.
  - Gross margin of 47-48%, including about 1 point from tariff refunds.
  - Foreign exchange as a sequential headwind of about 2.5 points.
  - Tax rate of about 16.5% and operating expenses of about $19.1-19.4B. These two come from secondary summaries only and are not verified.
  - The quarter includes 9 days of iPhone 18 Pro sales.
  - [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/10/06/apple-sets-q4-2026-earnings-release-for-november-2/), [Appleosophy](https://appleosophy.com/wire/52ouaji/), [iClarified](https://www.iclarified.com/101638/apple-details-supply-constraints-memory-costs-and-siri-ai-plans-during-q3-earnings-call), [Platformaeronaut](https://transcripts.platformaeronaut.com/summaries/AAPL-3Q26-AI-Summary)
- My own arithmetic, not a forecast:
  - At the guidance midpoints (revenue about $112.7B, 47.5% gross margin, $19.25B opex, about $0.3-0.5B other income, 16.5% tax, about 14.65B diluted shares), EPS comes to about $1.97.
  - At the top of the ranges it comes to about $2.06.
  - Diluted shares were 14.71B in Q3 FY2026 and are falling about 1.5% a year.

## 4. Base rates
- Apple's diluted GAAP EPS by quarter (from SEC 8-Ks):
  - Q3 FY2025 (June 2025): $1.57.
  - Q4 FY2025 (September 2025): $1.85. I did not re-fetch this figure; it is consistent with Zacks's +8.1% on $2.00.
  - Q1 FY2026: $2.84 (the six-month total of $4.85 minus Q2's $2.01).
  - Q2 FY2026: $2.01. [SEC 8-K Q2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000011/a8-kex991q2202603282026.htm)
  - Q3 FY2026: $2.02, which included a one-off +$0.11 from tariff refunds. Excluding that, about $1.91.
  - Q3 FY2026 detail: revenue $109.4B, gross margin 50.1%, opex $19.08B, other income +$0.57B, tax about 17.9%. [SEC 8-K Q3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000320193/000032019326000018/a8-kex991q3202606272026.htm)
- Apple has beaten consensus EPS in 8 of its last 8 quarters ([CME Elite/aggregators](https://www.cmelitegroup.com/knowledge-hub/apple-earnings-date/)). The latest beat was $2.02 against roughly $1.89 consensus, though $0.11 of that came from tariff refunds. Typical recent beats are about 1-7%, which is roughly $0.02-0.13 on a $2.00 base.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Will Apple beat quarterly earnings?": Yes at 0.815 (fetched 2026-10-28).
- Polymarket, Q4 iPhone revenue above a threshold:
  - Above $57B: 0.485.
  - Above $55.5B: 0.78.
  - Above $58.5B: 0.19.
- Kalshi: the only related Apple market is the earnings-call wording market, which tells us nothing about EPS. I found no Kalshi or Manifold market on the EPS figure itself.
- The analyst consensus range is $1.98-2.01 (see section 3).

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-10-28: Fed decision, with rates expected to stay unchanged. Microsoft and Alphabet also report, which may move sentiment but not Apple's already-closed quarter. [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/26/10/62610784/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-futures-trade-mixed-as-fed-begins-its-two-day-meet-nvs-hsbc-well-in-focus)
- 2026-11-02, about 20:30 UTC: Apple's release. This comes after forecasts close at 10:00 UTC.
- Things that could push the GAAP figure away from consensus:
  - The size of tariff refunds.
  - Memory costs.
  - Foreign exchange.
  - Any one-off tax items (Apple has had large one-time tax charges in past September quarters).
  - Other income/expense.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** about 5 days. Apple reports on November 2, 2026, around 20:30 UTC, and forecasts close earlier that day.

(b) **Latest known value:** Q3 FY2026 diluted GAAP EPS was $2.02, reported July 30, 2026. That figure included about $0.11 of one-off tariff refunds, so the underlying number was about $1.91.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about $2.00, which is Apple's guidance-implied EPS and in line with consensus.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** Apple has beaten consensus in 8 of its last 8 quarters, typically by 3-7%. Recent beats:
* Q4 FY2025: $1.85 against about $1.77.
* Q1 FY2026: $2.84 against about $2.67.
* Q2 FY2026: $2.01 against about $1.95.
* Q3 FY2026: $2.02 against about $1.89.

Applying a typical beat to a $1.98-2.01 consensus gives roughly $2.05-2.10.

(e) **Historical variation:** The September quarter is already closed, so the uncertainty is about the reported figure, not the business. Surprise against consensus is usually ±$0.02-0.13. Rare one-off tax items can cause large deviations: Q4 FY2024 reported $0.97 because of the EU state aid tax charge.

(f) **Expert and market expectations:**
* Consensus is $1.98-2.01: Zacks $2.00, MarketBeat $1.99, Yahoo $1.98, Goldman $2.01.
* Polymarket puts the chance of a beat at 81.5%.
* Guidance arithmetic gives about $1.97 at the midpoints and about $2.06 at the top of the ranges.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
* **Low:** A one-time tax charge or legal settlement, heavier memory-cost pressure on gross margin, or weak iPhone 18 launch-week sales could push EPS to about $1.90 or below. An EU-style tax charge could take it to around $1.
* **High:** Larger tariff refunds than guided, a gross margin above 48%, strong iPhone and Services results, or a favorable tax true-up could push EPS to about $2.15-2.20.

I center the distribution near $2.06 to reflect Apple's consistent beats, partly offset by memory-cost headwinds. I keep a modest left tail for one-off items.
